# zeroword_environment (Resource)

An Environment is one issuer (tenant) inside a Project. Deleting it is a soft delete in Zeroword.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zeroword_environment" "staging" {
  project_id = zeroword_project.app.id
  type       = "test"
  name       = "app-staging"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name (1-200 characters).
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`prj_...`).
- `type` (String) `test` or `production`. Changing it replaces the Environment.

### Optional

- `status` (String) `active` or `suspended`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Environment ID (`env_...`).
- `interaction_domain` (String) Hosted Login host.
- `issuer` (String) OIDC issuer URL.
- `rp_id` (String) WebAuthn Relying Party ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import zeroword_environment.staging env_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
